mapper.sql: l.child_thread_id AS taskThreadId,l.parent_thread_id AS parentThreadId,l.root_thread_id AS rootThreadId, l.origin_turn_id AS originTurnId,t.title AS taskName,l.depth,l.task_kind AS taskKind,l.lifecycle, l.context_seed_id AS contextSeedId,l.created_at AS createdAt,p.revision,p.state, p.latest_activity_sequence AS latestActivitySequence,p.last_seen_activity_sequence AS lastSeenActivitySequence, p.unread_count AS unreadCount,p.descendant_count AS descendantCount, p.running_descendant_count AS runningDescendantCount,p.needs_attention_count AS needsAttentionCount, p.latest_safe_summary AS latestSafeSummary,p.started_at AS startedAt,p.completed_at AS completedAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT t.thread_id AS threadId,t.workspace_id AS workspaceId,t.access_mode AS accessMode,t.revision, l.root_thread_id AS rootThreadId,l.depth FROM threads t LEFT JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT thread_id AS threadId,root_turn_id AS rootTurnId,state, cancel_requested_at AS cancelRequestedAt FROM turns WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT t.thread_id AS threadId,l.root_thread_id AS rootThreadId,l.depth,t.title, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temporary_side_chats c WHERE c.thread_id=t.thread_id AND c.state='CLOSING') AS closing FROM threads t LEFT JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM thread_lineage WHERE root_thread_id=#{rootThreadId}

INSERT INTO task_activities(activity_id,root_thread_id,task_thread_id,actor_thread_id,causal_turn_id,kind, summary_json,created_at) VALUES(#{activityId},#{rootThreadId},#{taskThreadId},#{actorThreadId},#{causalTurnId},#{kind}, #{summaryJson},#{createdAt}) RETURNING activity_sequence
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{parentThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN ancestors a ON l.child_thread_id=a.thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) UPDATE task_projections SET descendant_count=descendant_count+1,revision=revision+1 WHERE task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM ancestors) AND descendant_count<64

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(thread_id) AS ( SELECT parent_thread_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE child_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN ancestors a ON l.child_thread_id=a.thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) UPDATE task_projections AS p SET descendant_count=(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(thread_id) AS ( SELECT child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE parent_thread_id=p.task_thread_id AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN descendants d ON l.parent_thread_id=d.thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM descendants), running_descendant_count=(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(thread_id) AS ( SELECT child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE parent_thread_id=p.task_thread_id AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN descendants d ON l.parent_thread_id=d.thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_projections WHERE task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM descendants) AND state='RUNNING'), needs_attention_count=(WITH RECURSIVE descendants(thread_id) AS ( SELECT child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE parent_thread_id=p.task_thread_id AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN descendants d ON l.parent_thread_id=d.thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_projections WHERE task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM descendants) AND state IN ('WAITING_APPROVAL','SUSPENDED')), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE p.task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM ancestors)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM thread_lineage l JOIN task_projections p ON p.task_thread_id=l.child_thread_id JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=l.child_thread_id WHERE l.child_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM thread_lineage l JOIN task_projections p ON p.task_thread_id=l.child_thread_id JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=l.child_thread_id WHERE l.root_thread_id=#{rootThreadId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.depth,l.created_at,l.child_thread_id

SELECT a.activity_sequence AS activitySequence,a.activity_id AS activityId, a.root_thread_id AS activityRootThreadId,a.task_thread_id AS activityTaskThreadId, a.actor_thread_id AS actorThreadId,a.causal_turn_id AS causalTurnId, a.kind AS activityKind,a.summary_json AS activitySummaryJson,a.created_at AS activityCreatedAt, l.child_thread_id AS lineageTaskThreadId,l.parent_thread_id AS parentThreadId, l.root_thread_id AS lineageRootThreadId,l.origin_turn_id AS originTurnId,t.title AS taskName, l.depth,l.task_kind AS taskKind,l.lifecycle,l.context_seed_id AS contextSeedId, l.created_at AS lineageCreatedAt,p.task_thread_id AS projectionTaskThreadId, p.root_thread_id AS projectionRootThreadId,p.revision AS projectionRevision, p.state AS projectionState,p.latest_activity_sequence AS latestActivitySequence, p.last_seen_activity_sequence AS lastSeenActivitySequence,p.unread_count AS unreadCount, p.descendant_count AS descendantCount,p.running_descendant_count AS runningDescendantCount, p.needs_attention_count AS needsAttentionCount,p.latest_safe_summary AS latestSafeSummary, p.started_at AS startedAt,p.completed_at AS completedAt,p.updated_at AS projectionUpdatedAt, t.thread_id AS persistedThreadId,t.deleted_at AS threadDeletedAt FROM ( SELECT activity_sequence,activity_id,root_thread_id,task_thread_id,actor_thread_id, causal_turn_id,kind,summary_json,created_at FROM task_activities WHERE task_thread_id IN ( SELECT child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE parent_thread_id=#{rootThreadId} AND task_kind='SUBAGENT' AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) ORDER BY activity_sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) a LEFT JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=a.task_thread_id LEFT JOIN task_projections p ON p.task_thread_id=a.task_thread_id LEFT JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=a.task_thread_id ORDER BY a.activity_sequence

SELECT s.context_seed_id AS contextSeedId,s.parent_thread_id AS parentThreadId, s.parent_turn_id AS parentTurnId,s.parent_revision AS parentRevision, s.inheritance_mode AS inheritanceMode,s.task_brief_json AS taskBriefJson, s.effective_context_json AS effectiveContextJson,s.references_json AS referencesJson, s.permission_ceiling_json AS permissionCeilingJson,s.fingerprint,s.created_at AS createdAt FROM task_context_seeds s JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.context_seed_id=s.context_seed_id WHERE l.child_thread_id=#{taskThreadId}

SELECT mailbox_sequence AS mailboxSequence,message_id AS messageId,root_thread_id AS rootThreadId, sender_thread_id AS senderThreadId,sender_title AS senderTitle, target_thread_id AS targetThreadId,causal_turn_id AS causalTurnId, kind,content_json AS contentJson,idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey,state,bound_turn_id AS boundTurnId, created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,consumed_at AS consumedAt FROM task_mailbox WHERE (sender_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} OR target_thread_id=#{taskThreadId}) AND mailbox_sequence>#{afterSequence} ORDER BY mailbox_sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT mailbox_sequence AS mailboxSequence,message_id AS messageId,root_thread_id AS rootThreadId, sender_thread_id AS senderThreadId,sender_title AS senderTitle, target_thread_id AS targetThreadId,causal_turn_id AS causalTurnId, kind,content_json AS contentJson,idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey,state,bound_turn_id AS boundTurnId, created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,consumed_at AS consumedAt FROM task_mailbox WHERE sender_thread_id=#{senderThreadId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pendingCount,COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(content_json AS BLOB))),0) AS pendingBytes FROM task_mailbox WHERE target_thread_id=#{targetThreadId} AND state IN ('PENDING','BOUND')

INSERT INTO task_mailbox(message_id,root_thread_id,sender_thread_id,sender_title,target_thread_id,causal_turn_id,kind, content_json,idempotency_key,state,bound_turn_id,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{messageId},#{rootThreadId},#{senderThreadId},t.title,#{targetThreadId},#{causalTurnId},#{kind}, #{contentJson},#{idempotencyKey},#{state},#{boundTurnId},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt} FROM threads t WHERE t.thread_id=#{senderThreadId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT(sender_thread_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING mailbox_sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE task_mailbox SET state='BOUND',bound_turn_id=#{boundTurnId},updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND target_thread_id=#{targetThreadId} AND kind='FOLLOW_UP' AND state='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT mailbox_sequence AS mailboxSequence,message_id AS messageId,root_thread_id AS rootThreadId, sender_thread_id AS senderThreadId,sender_title AS senderTitle, target_thread_id AS targetThreadId,causal_turn_id AS causalTurnId, kind,content_json AS contentJson,idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey,state,bound_turn_id AS boundTurnId, created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,consumed_at AS consumedAt FROM task_mailbox WHERE bound_turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='BOUND' ORDER BY mailbox_sequence LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_mailbox SET state='CONSUMED',consumed_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE bound_turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='BOUND'
UPDATE task_mailbox SET state='PENDING',bound_turn_id=NULL,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE bound_turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='BOUND'

UPDATE task_projections SET revision=revision+1, state=CASE WHEN state IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') THEN state ELSE 'QUEUED' END, latest_activity_sequence=#{latestActivitySequence},unread_count=unread_count+1, latest_safe_summary=#{latestSafeSummary}, completed_at=CASE WHEN state IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') THEN completed_at ELSE NULL END, updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE task_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}

UPDATE task_projections SET revision=revision+1,last_seen_activity_sequence=#{throughActivitySequence}, unread_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_activities a WHERE a.task_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND a.activity_sequence>#{throughActivitySequence}), updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE task_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND #{throughActivitySequence}<=latest_activity_sequence AND #{throughActivitySequence}>=COALESCE(last_seen_activity_sequence,0)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE attached(child_thread_id,depth) AS ( SELECT child_thread_id,depth FROM thread_lineage WHERE parent_thread_id=#{parentThreadId} AND lifecycle='ATTACHED' UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id,l.depth FROM thread_lineage l JOIN attached a ON l.parent_thread_id=a.child_thread_id WHERE l.lifecycle='ATTACHED' ) SELECT FROM attached x JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=x.child_thread_id JOIN task_projections p ON p.task_thread_id=l.child_thread_id JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=l.child_thread_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.depth,l.created_at,l.child_thread_id

SELECT DISTINCT parent.thread_id AS parentThreadId,parent.turn_id AS parentTurnId FROM turns parent JOIN thread_lineage child_lineage ON child_lineage.parent_thread_id=parent.thread_id AND child_lineage.origin_turn_id=parent.turn_id AND child_lineage.lifecycle='ATTACHED' JOIN turns child_turn ON child_turn.thread_id=child_lineage.child_thread_id WHERE parent.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND child_turn.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY parent.requested_at,parent.turn_id

SELECT l.child_thread_id AS taskThreadId,l.parent_thread_id AS parentThreadId, l.root_thread_id AS rootThreadId,l.task_kind AS taskKind, p.revision AS taskRevision,p.state AS taskState FROM turns x JOIN thread_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=x.thread_id JOIN task_projections p ON p.task_thread_id=l.child_thread_id WHERE x.turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT state FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND turn_id<>#{settledTurnId} AND state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY requested_at,turn_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_projections WHERE task_thread_id=#{taskThreadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree) AND state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tree
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) UPDATE threads SET deleted_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=#{occurredAt},revision=revision+1 WHERE thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree) AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) DELETE FROM workspace_write_claims WHERE thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) DELETE FROM task_mailbox WHERE sender_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree) OR target_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) DELETE FROM task_activities WHERE task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) DELETE FROM task_projections WHERE task_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) SELECT context_seed_id FROM thread_lineage WHERE child_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)
mapper.delete: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{taskThreadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM thread_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id ) DELETE FROM thread_lineage WHERE child_thread_id IN (SELECT thread_id FROM tree)
DELETE FROM task_context_seeds WHERE context_seed_id IN #{seedId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(fencing_token),0)+1 FROM workspace_write_claims WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId}
UPDATE task_process_generation SET last_generation=last_generation+1 WHERE singleton_id=1 RETURNING last_generation

INSERT INTO workspace_write_claims(claim_id,workspace_id,thread_id,turn_id,process_generation,fencing_token, state,requested_at) VALUES(#{claimId},#{workspaceId},#{threadId},#{turnId},#{processGeneration},#{fencingToken},'WAITING',#{requestedAt}) RETURNING claim_sequence

SELECT claim_sequence AS claimSequence,claim_id AS claimId,workspace_id AS workspaceId,thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId,process_generation AS processGeneration,fencing_token AS fencingToken,state, requested_at AS requestedAt,acquired_at AS acquiredAt,heartbeat_at AS heartbeatAt,released_at AS releasedAt FROM workspace_write_claims WHERE claim_id=#{claimId}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_write_claims SET state='HELD',acquired_at=#{occurredAt},heartbeat_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND state='WAITING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_write_claims held WHERE held.workspace_id=workspace_write_claims.workspace_id AND held.state='HELD') AND claim_sequence=(SELECT MIN(waiting.claim_sequence) FROM workspace_write_claims waiting WHERE waiting.workspace_id=workspace_write_claims.workspace_id AND waiting.state='WAITING')
UPDATE workspace_write_claims SET heartbeat_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND state='HELD'
UPDATE workspace_write_claims SET state='RELEASED',released_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND state='HELD'
UPDATE workspace_write_claims SET state='ABANDONED',released_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE claim_id=#{claimId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND state IN ('WAITING','HELD')
UPDATE workspace_write_claims SET state='ABANDONED',released_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE state IN ('WAITING','HELD')
